title: Find a record after hash collisions
description: Implement lookup(table, key). table is a nonempty fixed-size linear-probing hash table containing non-negative integer keys or None; keys were inserted using key % len(table), with wraparound and no deletions. Return the matching index or -1. Stop on None or after inspecting every slot. Do not mutate table or use list.index. Empty table returns -1.
hints: Separate validation, state changes and output.
Try an empty case, an exact boundary and repeated operations.
